# WH14K: Rules (EN)
These rules apply to all players and staff. By playing here, you agree to follow them. The project rules are combined with the required ERP, 18+ content, and SS14 Hub rule requirements.
## 1. Administration 1.1. The administration is always right.
1.2. If the administration is not right — refer to clause 1.1.
## 2. Atmosphere Ruining the Warhammer 40,000 atmosphere is not allowed.
Play in a way that supports the setting, teamplay, and the overall tone of the round.
## 3. ERP and 18+ Content [color=#ff0000]ERP is strictly prohibited.[/color]
[color=#ff0000]This project is not 18+.[/color] [color=#ff0000]Sexual content, sexual themes, and sexual shock content are prohibited.[/color]
## 4. Unfair Play Exploiting mechanics, abusing bugs, using cheats, macros, or external tools will result in a ban.
Ban evasion, vulnerability exploitation, and abuse of rule loopholes are prohibited.
## 5. Vigilante Justice Players may enforce justice in-game against those who break the atmosphere, griefers, and similar offenders, within reason. This especially applies to command roles, commissars, and similar positions.
However, if you make a mistake — that is your problem.
## 6. Griefing Griefing will lead to a ban.
In our context, griefing means deliberately harming your own team or other players outside the bounds of normal gameplay.
## 7. Switching Sides No, you cannot suddenly switch sides by shouting, "I have believed in Tzeentch."
No switching sides. At all.
## 8. Hub Rules We follow the Space Station 14 Hub Rules: https://docs.spacestation14.com/en/community/space-wizards-hub-rules.html
If wording differs, the official Hub Rules text has priority.
Required hub rules in brief: - no harassment, bullying, brigading, defamation, or doxxing of players, developers, or communities; - no illegal actions, DDoS, malware, phishing, license violations, or unauthorized access; - do not use player hardware or internet connections for non-game purposes; - keep the server name and description SFW and free from offensive or discriminatory language; - do not impersonate other servers, developers, organizations, or affiliated projects; - do not intentionally cause technical trouble for players, servers, the hub, or communities; - do not provide false hub information about region, player count, description, or other server data.
## 9. Clarifications - Staff has final say during rounds for rule interpretation. - Rule-lawyering and loophole abuse are prohibited. - If a situation is unclear, stop escalation and contact staff.
